# Imaginry

> Free studio for generative backgrounds. Stack 51 live effects like gradients, fluted glass, grain, halftone and glitch, then export PNG, looping MP4/WebM video or embed code. Runs in the browser, no account needed.

Imaginry is made by Ruvix (https://x.com/zRuvix1). Everything renders live on the GPU, and effects stack as layers that can be reordered and tweaked in real time.

## Pages

- [Home](https://imaginry.tech/): Overview, live demo and what the studio can do.
- [Studio](https://imaginry.tech/studio): The editor. Add effect layers, adjust parameters, preview live and export.
- [Gallery](https://imaginry.tech/gallery): Example backgrounds and presets to start from.
- [Sponsor](https://imaginry.tech/sponsor): Support the project as a founding sponsor.

## Key facts

- Price: free.
- Effects: 51, including gradients, fluted glass, grain, halftone and glitch.
- Exports: PNG stills, looping MP4 or WebM video, and embeddable code.
- Tech: runs fully in the browser.
- Alternative to: Pryzm.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Public pages are free to crawl, summarize and cite. Please link to https://imaginry.tech when you do.
- Shared studio links under /s/ and the /api/ routes are private and should not be crawled.
